10_five_family_resource_smoke.detail: five-family combined parallel resource smoke (100 threads) -- 5 families x both directions, delta=0.1, start=1, 20 threads each (100 total), real 2026-07-30/31 run. Peak RSS per family: unrestricted=12.4GB flexible_cm=32.9GB common_frechet=37.9GB origin_zc=17.2GB cm_meanzc=21.2GB (worst-case concurrent sum ~122GB vs 3.0TiB available). Zero crashes/OOM/resource errors across ~90 min sustained 100-thread concurrent execution. Convergence within the artificially short 1800s smoke budget: unrestricted/flexible_cm/common_frechet reached verified DONE on both cells; origin_zc on 1 of 2; cm_meanzc on 0 of 2 within 1800s x 3 attempts (deterministic stall after eval 3 across all 3 independent attempts, but still genuinely computing inside KN_solve when killed -- not a crash or hang). Follow-up isolated diagnostic (no contention, 2400s internal budget) confirmed cm_meanzc is NOT stuck: it reached a genuine verified DONE at wall=2663.9s (44 min), n_eval=21, best_Delta=0.0946 vs target 0.1 -- well within the real 10,800s/cell production budget (~4x headroom even under contention-free timing). Conclusion: resource consumption is not a blocker (ample RAM headroom, no crashes); the artificial 1800s smoke budget under 5-way contention understates real per-cell convergence time for the two heavier CM-restriction families (cm_meanzc, and to a lesser extent origin_zc), but the real 10,800s/cell budget is corroborated as sufficient by the isolated follow-up test.
